concept.title: Safe help with domestic abuse
concept.shortdesc: As someone experiencing domestic abuse, I need to find safe, confidential help, so that I can get to safety.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-022). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: May be searching on a shared or monitored device.
A good result: The national helpline and local specialist services first, with safe-use guidance and no results that could endanger her.
How much it matters: Safety: a miss could leave someone at risk, so the bar is highest.

ul.li: how do I leave an abusive relationship safely
